blocks.heading: Outbox claim
blocks.text: The outbox worker claims pending vector events before publishing them to Qdrant.

blocks.heading: Retry behavior
blocks.text: Failed outbox events are retried until they either complete successfully or move to a dead-letter state.

blocks.heading: Staleness metric
blocks.text: Outbox staleness measures the delay between event creation and successful processing.

blocks.heading: Projection
blocks.text: Qdrant stores the vector projection while PostgreSQL remains the source of truth.

blocks.heading: Payload filters
blocks.text: Payload filters include access_zone_id, access_level, lifecycle_status and expires_at_epoch.

blocks.heading: Repair
blocks.text: A missing Qdrant point must be repaired from PostgreSQL vector bindings during reconciliation.

title: Hybrid retrieval with dense and sparse signals

blocks.heading: Dense paraphrase
blocks.text: Dense retrieval should find semantically similar paraphrases even when exact words are different.

blocks.heading: Sparse rare term
blocks.text: Sparse retrieval should preserve rare lexical terms such as ZX-451-ALPHA-RAIL.

blocks.heading: Fusion
blocks.text: Hybrid search combines dense and sparse scores to rank the expected context above single-mode results.

blocks.heading: TTL cleanup
blocks.text: TTL cleanup expires documents and schedules vector deletion through the outbox.

blocks.heading: Legal hold
blocks.text: Legal hold prevents TTL deletion even when the document expiration time has passed.

blocks.heading: Consistency check
blocks.text: A valid TTL cleanup must not leave stale Qdrant points visible to RetrieveContext.
